note: Town of Drummond campground (built 2013 with a WI DNR ATV grant; town-owned, inside the Chequamegon NF), across the street from the Drummond Public Library, which takes reservations. It sits at the trailhead of the area's ATV trail system and adjoins a town park with a swim beach, picnic pavilion and paved boat landing on Drummond Lake. The upper loop (sites 1-17) is open and grassy; the lower loop (18-27) is wooded on a rise above the lake's marshy south shore. --Claude
summary: Operator site (moved to drummond-lake-campground.squarespace.com; the stored .com domain is now parked) gives upper sites $35, lower $45, $3.50 booking fee (stored $25 was the late-season electric-only drop-in rate); 27 RV (21 FHU, 6 W/E, all 20/30/50A) + 3 tent; flush toilets, coin showers, dump; May-October; books on Firefly or via the library. Not waterfront kept.
flags: WEBSITE: https://www.drummondlakecampground.com now serves a GoDaddy parking lander (redirects to /lander, read 2026-11-16; it carried the campground site on 2026-10-15). The same operator site is live at https://drummond-lake-campground.squarespace.com/ . Proposed website lines: https://drummond-lake-campground.squarespace.com/ and https://www.drummondwi.com/town-officials (Town page) - replacing both stored drummondlakecampground.com lines. The Town page still links the dead .com, so the domain may come back.
PHONE: 715-739-6290 (Drummond Public Library, reservations) confirmed on both the campground and Town pages; the campground's drop-in cell is 715-580-0016 (in booking.note).

OHV FLAG (reviewer decides): the operator markets itself as 'ATV friendly', 'sits at the trailhead of a vast ATV trail system', was built with a DNR ATV grant and lets ATVs wash at the dump station. It is also an ordinary town campground beside a town beach park on Drummond Lake with hookup sites any camper books; I read it as a general campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp.

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. Imagery: the lower loop (18-27, ~46.3379,-91.2617) is in trees ~70 m from the lake's marshy weed-bed edge and ~130 m from open water; the upper loop (1-17, ~46.3372,-91.2606) is ~200 m from open water behind the town beach park. LEAD for a lakeview: Firefly descriptions claim a lake view at site 6 ('view of lake'), 7 ('Fire ring situated to enjoy the lake view'), 18 ('Top of the "peak" with a great view') and 20 ('Another great view of Drummond Lake!'); imagery shows tree cover between the lower loop and the water, and I could not see a lake view from the pads, so I leave it down.

Fit: every RV site is 45 ft or more (Firefly); our 23-ft motorhome search returned 'Equipment type not allowed' on site 16 only (no reason given). 2027 is not loaded (all sites blocked for June 2027), and a second search hit Firefly's reCAPTCHA, so no live 2027 price.
Pin 46.3367,-91.2597 sits on the overflow lot ~90-150 m SE of the loops; within 250 m, kept (loops' centre ~46.3375,-91.2611).
